title.narrative: U.S. Peace Corps Volunteer Safety and Security

description.narrative: Volunteer safety and security costs in Worldwide locations directly associated with Volunteer and staff safety (preparedness and training), and the physical security of Peace Corps-leased properties. Includes guard services, security staff, security-related travel, supplies, equipment, physical property upgrades, and the Office of Safety and Security.
